NOTICE OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE J6, K41, AND J33 LANDOWNER GROUP

       AND APPLICANT CONCERNING APPLICANT'S OBJECTIONS TO THE

                            TESTIMONY OF FOSTER MILLER

       COMES NOW, The J6, K41, And J33 Landowner Group, and files this Notice of

Agreement with Applicants Oncor Electric Delivery Company and LCRA Transmission Service

Corporation concerning an objection they leveled to the Direct Testimony of Foster Miller,

Interchange Item Number 4486.

       The parties reached the following agreement: if the Landowner Group would withdraw the

following sentence on page 5, “After consulting with other brokers in the area, we are deeply

concerned that Testimony of this project will devalue our land by a minimum of 50%,” the

Applicants would agree to withdraw their objection to the remaining testimony on page 5.

       Accordingly, the J6, K41, And J33 Landowner Group will file an amended version of the

Direct Testimony of Foster Miller with said redaction.

Notice of Agreement: J6, K41                                                                1
and J33 Landowner Group
